gates.status: three paired seeds reproduce cecum inversion in all contact-enabled DemoPolicy paths while exact-action contact-disabled controls all pass; reset-contact telemetry was fixed and rechecked. A 3/6/12 mm/s probe changes severity but does not prevent inversion. A kf=0 trial was a no-op for VBD tool/FEM contact: Newton source shows that formulation consumes averaged mu, ke and kd, not ShapeConfig.kf. The app now overrides mu on both soft and instrument sides. A same-seed-range zero-mu probe avoids inversion for all three scripted seeds, but raises peak nodal speed to 85–136 mm/s, sharply reduces the uncalibrated wrench channel, and completes zero stages; it is not promoted. A same-seed 10x contact-ke reduction also fails with two inverted cecum tets and a slightly more negative minimum signed-volume ratio; its action path changes. A same-seed 96-iteration 6.5 s follow-up yielded no physics result: the process stopped making CPU/GPU progress while the main worker waited on Windows IPC and had to be interrupted. A finer live-FEM cecum surface clearance heuristic with batched queries passed focused tests but repeated the same action path and two-cecum-tet inversion at 6.133 s on seed 20261006; contact mechanics remain uncalibrated.
